description: Test harness and mock setup for Discord outbound adapter, including mock creation, module mocking, and helper functions for testing Discord message sending and thread management.

methods.name: invokeMock
methods.description: Helper function to invoke a mock with arguments and cast the result.

methods.name: createDiscordOutboundHoisted
methods.description: Creates a hoisted object containing mock functions for Discord message sending and thread management.

methods.name: createDiscordSendModuleMock
methods.description: Creates a mock version of the send module, replacing its methods with mocked implementations.

methods.name: createDiscordSendComponentsModuleMock
methods.description: Creates a mock version of the send components module with mocked methods.

methods.name: createDiscordThreadBindingsModuleMock
methods.description: Creates a mock version of the thread bindings module with mocked methods.

methods.name: installDiscordOutboundModuleSpies
methods.description: Sets up spies on the actual modules to replace their methods with mocked implementations.

methods.name: resetDiscordOutboundMocks
methods.description: Resets all mocks to their default resolved values.

methods.name: expectDiscordThreadBotSend
methods.description: Asserts that the send message mock was called with expected parameters and that the result matches the default.

methods.name: mockDiscordBoundThreadManager
methods.description: Mocks the thread binding manager to return a predefined thread info object.
